note: The official key accepts only var-1, but var 1 is not a valid name either: a variable name cannot contain a space, so var 1 = 5 is also a SyntaxError. var-1 fails because Python reads it as var minus 1.
The official key accepts A and C, but D is not a way to read a decimal either: a = int(a) turns the text into a whole number, and int('2.5') raises a ValueError. Only float(input()) reads a decimal.
